title: Feature-flag-gated scene flashes 404 before flags load
answers: Scene shows not found page briefly then the real page loads
404 flash on feature-flagged scene on first load
Flag-gated page shows NotFound before posthog-js flags arrive
How to gate a scene on a feature flag without flashing NotFound
body:
Symptom: A staff member opens a flag-gated scene (decisions playground) and sees the not-found page for a moment before the real page renders.
Root cause: products/ml_inference/frontend/DecisionPlaygroundScene.tsx:DecisionPlaygroundScene read an unset `featureFlags[...]` as off; on first load the flag is unset until posthog-js returns flags.
Fix pattern: Read `receivedFeatureFlags` from `featureFlagLogic` and `featureFlagsTimedOut` from `appLogic`. When the flag is falsy, render `<NotFound>` only if `receivedFeatureFlags || featureFlagsTimedOut`; otherwise render `<Spinner className="text-3xl mx-auto my-8" />`.
Constraints: Applies to scenes that render NotFound based on a flag. A flag already true (persisted flags, or pinned in a Storybook story) renders immediately, so snapshots are unchanged. Keep the timeout branch, otherwise a failed flags request leaves the spinner up forever.
applies: Frontend scenes that return NotFound when a feature flag is off (e.g. products/ml_inference decisions playground).
